newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Henderson mulls HK$20 bln flat sales in H2.
newsitem.headline: Henderson mulls HK$20 bln flat sales in H2.

text.p: Henderson Land Development Co Ltd said on Wednesday it would launch five to six residential projects worth HK$20 billion later in 1997.

"We expect to launch five to six developments in the rest of 1997 depending on how soon the government grants us the sales consents," said Donald Cheung, general manager of sales of department of Henderson Land, told Reuters.
"Revenue from the flats sales (from the developments) is expected to reach HK$20 billion, exceeding the total sales revenue of HK$13 billion for whole of 1996," Cheung added.
Cheung said revenue for the first four months of 1997 was estimated to be about HK$4 billion, up about 10 percent from the same period in 1996.

The residential developments put for sales later in 1997 will comprise two developments in Sai Wan Ho and Shaukeiwan on Hong Kong Island, and the remainings are in Yuen Long, Fanling and Tseung Kwan O in New Territories, Cheung said.

Among the sales, about 3,000 units covering an aggregate saleable floor area of 1.6 million square feet will be from the Fanling development. About 2,100 units with a total saleable floor area of 1.3 million square feet will be from the Tseung Kwan O development, Cheung added.
